subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Emergency Fund Psychology
description: A short lesson to help you apply Emergency Fund Psychology.

hook.text: 39% of Americans can't cover a $400 emergency. They have Netflix, gym memberships, and coffee habits.

buildup.text: Saving for emergencies is hard because the reward is invisible: preventing pain.

discovery.text: Labeling a savings account 'Emergency Fund' increases deposits. The mental label creates a dedicated account.

twist.text: Round-up apps that save spare change work because the amounts are too small to trigger the pain of paying.

climax.text: The best emergency fund strategy: automate, label, and make withdrawals slightly difficult.

punchline.text: Save automatically. The habit matters more than the amount.

quiz.question: Why do labeled savings accounts increase deposits?
options: The mental label creates a dedicated account with protective rules
